name: Cities: Skylines
description: Cities: Skylines is a popular city-building simulation with sophisticated agent-based modeling of traffic, citizens, and services. Players zone land, build infrastructure, and balance growth, pollution, happiness, and economy in a highly detailed urban environment.
reputation: One of the most successful and moddable city builders, frequently used in urban planning education and discussion.
notes: Famous for 1:1 agent simulation of individual citizens and vehicles; sequel addressed graphics but faced optimization challenges.
